description:
We are Smart Phoenix, a creative and passionate team interested in exploring new ideas through science, technology, creativity, and innovation.
Our interests include Videography & Photography, Planets & Moons, Business & Economics, Education, Flora & Fauna, Habitats, and Storytelling. We enjoy learning, sharing ideas, creating engaging content, and developing innovative solutions.
We welcome members who are creative, responsible, and willing to learn. We are looking for skills in video editing
summary:
SpaceLegacy+: A Discovery Dashboard for NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars 
SpaceLegacy+ is an interactive web-based dashboard that collects and analyzes NASA's publicly available mission data about discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. It transforms historical information about spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific instruments into interactive maps, mission timelines, and AI-powered stories. Our platform allows users to discover where these objects are located, why they were left behind, and how they contributed to space exploration.
details:
The Ghosts of Space is an educational project by Team Smart Phoenix that explores abandoned NASA equipment on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. Our project combines an interactive website and a two-minute educational video to share the stories, purposes, and scientific importance of these forgotten objects.

Using NASA resources, digital design, and video-editing tools, we present space exploration in a creative and engaging way. Our goal is to increase young people's interest in science, technology, and space exploration while showing that forgotten space equipment still has valuable stories to tell.
